DLC2317:4:t_110:3.en:
$$カナリア$$
「You'll understand someday too, $$ルカ$$.」

DLC2317:4:t_111:0.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「My apologies, Captain $$ガムリン$$. We have dragged you into the trouble between $$ミスリル$$ and $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$」

DLC2317:4:t_111:1.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Think nothing of it, Captain $$クルーゾー$$. Compared to supporting $$バサラ$$, this is easy.」

DLC2317:4:t_111:2.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Then tonight, let me see you as a soldier. I have long admired those spirited punches of yours, Captain.」

DLC2317:4:t_111:3.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「I'm honored. Then I'll do everything I can to live up to your expectations!」

DLC2317:4:t_112:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Watching young people push one another to improve is enough to lift one's spirits.」

DLC2317:4:t_112:3.en:
$$ボビー$$
「Boss! Isn't it a little early to start talking like a retiree!?」

DLC2317:4:t_112:5.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Let's do this, you lot! Show those scoundrels how $c fights!」
